headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout ball. Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense with a single, RBI, and 3 at-bats. The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 8-7, with Ryan O'Hearn leading the Pirates' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Cincinnati Reds placed first baseman Spencer Steer on the 10-day injured list due to a right wrist sprain. The New York Yankees placed left fielder Cody Bellinger on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. The Athletics placed catcher Shea Langeliers on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 25, 2026, with a torn meniscus in his right knee.

The St. Louis Cardinals traded right-handed pitcher Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded right-handed pitcher José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for right-handed pitcher Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded left-handed pitcher Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for third baseman Curtis Mead. The Kansas City Royals traded center fielder Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 7.0 innings of shutout ball, striking out 9 and walking 1. Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense with a single, RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. Max Kranick pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief, striking out 1 batter without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 8-7 in a closely contested matchup. Ryan O'Hearn led the Pirates' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rout Blue Jays 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 6-1 victory. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Place Spencer Steer on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds first baseman Spencer Steer has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right wrist sprain. The injury occurred on an unspecified date.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash on July 26, 2026.
